UNVALIDATED — No advance-warning skill, calibration or economic effect size has been demonstrated. AMENDMENT-03 measured Pillar 1 at approximately no skill at every intraday horizon and reclassified it as a contagion diagnostic, and the research replay records empirical_acceptance as unvalidated. These are honest limitations of a working instrument, not grounds for treating its output as a validated forecast.

What is predicted

probability that the research market index falls 10% or more from this decision close at any close within the next 15 sessions

Model: combined (EWMA volatility + one feature per pillar family) · fit fitted on 5229 rows, using labels matured through 2026-08-13 (fitted 2026-09-03, 72 refits over the series). 5 of 5 features were observed at this date.

Measured — the three pillars at this close

feature values at the decision date, computed from data available at that close; parameters estimated through t-1

Warning policy

The threshold is recalibrated from past out-of-sample scores and matured outcomes only, to hold at most 2.0 false episodes per year and keep at most 10% of sessions in alarm, over a 1260-session lookback needing 252 matured outcomes. 68 recalibrations so far. the threshold is chosen from past out-of-sample scores and matured outcomes only. A frozen threshold is a policy, not a proof that the future false-alarm budget will be met

4489 forecasts with matured outcomes, 307 of them positive. Alarms on 2.60% of assessable sessions across 19 episodes. retrospective replay over the available history. It shows what the instrument would have produced, which is implementation behaviour rather than demonstrated foresight

Calibration — did days it called p turn out p?

The uncertainty this model supports. It yields no interval, so this is the honest substitute: predicted against realised frequency, on matured labels only.
